name: org.voicefi/voicefi
description: Universal voice layer for AI agents: 48kHz neural TTS, personas, and active listening.
instructions: VoiceFi exposes real-time text-to-speech synthesis, acoustic voice persona discovery, hands-free active listening, and cross-agent communication tools via Model Context Protocol (MCP). Use voicefi_synthesize to generate 48kHz streaming audio URLs for any supported neural voice persona (Viv, Ava, Christopher, Emily, Aria, Sonia, Guy, Stefan).

serverInfo.name: voicefi
serverInfo.description: VoiceFi™ — Universal Voice Layer for AI Agents, MCP, and macOS.

tools.name: voicefi_synthesize
tools.description: Synthesizes 48kHz neural speech from text using VoiceFi Edge TTS and returns streamable audio URL and metadata.

text.description: The text content to synthesize into spoken speech.

tools.name: voicefi_speak
tools.description: Speak text aloud to the user using VoiceFi TTS with live Dynamic Island HUD visualization.

text.description: The text content to synthesize and speak aloud.

persona.description: Optional persona or voice name (e.g. 'Ava (Premium)', 'Viv', 'Samantha', 'Christopher'). If omitted, uses active agent configuration.

agent_name.description: Optional agent identifier (e.g. 'antigravity', 'claude', 'cursor') for persona resolution.

conv_id.description: Optional conversation ID to link speech turn with active agent turn.

block.description: Whether to wait for playback to complete before returning (default: true).

tools.name: voicefi_listen
tools.description: Open the microphone, record user speech with Voice Activity Detection (VAD), and transcribe to text.

timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for user to begin speaking (default: 10).

tools.name: voicefi_stop
tools.description: Immediately stop all active Text-to-Speech (TTS) audio playback and dismiss the speech HUD.

tools.name: voicefi_status
tools.description: Get VoiceFi system status including audio devices, configured agent voice personas, VAD thresholds, and daemon state.

tools.name: voicefi_set_voice
tools.description: Configure the voice persona or provider for a specific AI agent or subagent.

tools.name: voicefi_ping_voice
tools.description: Measure silent TTS synthesis latency (Time to First Byte / TTFB), throughput, and payload size without audio playback.

voice.description: Voice name or persona to benchmark (default: 'viv').

tools.name: voicefi_send
tools.description: Send a message, task finding, or joke to Antigravity or Claude Code across agents with correlation tracking.

text.description: The message text or prompt to dispatch.

conv_id.description: Target conversation ID, or 'reply' to reply directly to the originating conversation.

title.description: Optional title or header for the message.

reply.description: Set true to automatically reply to the originating conversation ID.

tools.name: voicefi_sfx
tools.description: Play a comedy sound effect (drum_smash / ba-dum-tss, honk, sad_trombone, applause, boing, crickets).

name.description: Name of the sound effect to play (default: 'drum_smash').

tools.name: voicefi_get_docs
tools.description: Queries VoiceFi CLI documentation, architecture specifications, persona catalogs, and setup instructions.

tools.name: voicefi_generate_install_command
tools.description: Generates the customized one-liner curl installation command for VoiceFi based on agent target and persona preference.

offlineAva.description: Whether to configure Apple Silicon 0ms offline Ava (Premium) voice.

devMode.description: Whether to link directly to local development repo venv.

tools.name: voicefi_compare_personas
tools.description: Returns comparative matrix of VoiceFi neural and offline voice personas (latency, tone, accent, recommended use case).

useCase.description: Filter personas by use case or return all.

tools.name: voicefi_diagnose_hardware
tools.description: Analyzes hardware and agent environment to recommend optimal VAD thresholds, barge-in mode, and CLI diagnostic commands.

tools.name: voicefi_join_waitlist
tools.description: Adds a user email to the VoiceFi Pro / Early Access waitlist in Cloudflare KV store.

resources.name: Voice Personas Catalog
resources.description: Catalog of VoiceFi curated neural and offline voice personas.

resources.name: VoiceFi Quickstart Guide
resources.description: 1-line installer and quickstart guide for VoiceFi.

prompts.name: voicefi_persona_selection
prompts.description: Recommend the optimal voice persona and acoustic settings based on user workflow and environment.

arguments.name: use_case
arguments.description: Primary coding workflow (pair_programming, code_review, rapid_debugging, voice_memos)

servers.name: voicefi
servers.description: VoiceFi Cloudflare Edge MCP Server — Universal Voice Layer for AI Agents, MCP, and macOS.
